items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: his daughter and I became staunch friends

ctx.x: Yeah. Because there was a German blacksmith when I was in Pittsburgh, and I was going to school with his daughter, and he was such a fantastic blacksmith that everyone would come and bring their horse to him. Even my grandfather had two mules, and everyone would -- Mr. Kramer, his name was. And his daughter and I became staunch friends, and we used to go to school arm in arm, you know, and he would always just pat me and say, 'Good boy, Kenny.'
